courses.name: Our climate, plainly
courses.why: Climate is argued about every day; knowing how the system works, with the measured numbers, lets you follow any claim back to what is really happening.
units: Steady emissions still fill the air
The Colorado River: more promised than it carries

sources.title: Global Carbon Budget 2025
sources.licenceSeen: Article page: "This work is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License"
sources.needIt: The yearly count of how much carbon goes into the air and how much the ocean and land take back, the numbers every climate claim rests on.
sources.notes: Table 7 (decadal means, 2024 and the 2025 projection) is a picture on the page; read from it by eye on 22 Nov 2026. 1 ppm = 2.124 GtC as stated in the methods.
